component.name: Token Trail
component.summary: Privacy-first dashboard for understanding local Codex usage

description.p: Token Trail connects to a locally installed OpenAI Codex app-server and presents account quota windows, token usage, and credit information in one read-only desktop dashboard.

All usage values are read through approved Codex methods, kept in memory only, and never transmitted anywhere by Token Trail. Every displayed value identifies whether it was reported by Codex, observed locally, calculated from complete or partial ranges, or is unavailable.

ul.li: Quota windows with used and remaining percentages, reset times, and provenance
Daily token usage with charts, calendar heatmap, statistics, and an accessible table
Credit balance, spending limits, and reset-credit expiry overview
Redacted diagnostics export containing no account data

description.p: Development preview of the read-only Codex usage dashboard.
